title: T1 NSFNet NSS Dismantling - January 1993
redistribution_notes: Preserve metadata and archive link; avoid bulk mirroring personal correspondence without rights review.

provenance.chain_notes: Contemporary operational announcement retained in public mailing-list archive.

claims_extracted.claim: By late December 1992, traffic had transitioned from the T1 NSFNET to T3 infrastructure and the T1 network was described as entirely dismantled.
Hosting regional networks were offered former NSS IBM RT workstations as donations, with approximately 4–6 RTs available at each T1 NSS site.
claims_extracted.notes: Potential starting point for serial-number/recipient provenance tracing.

claims_extracted.claim: Most offered RTs lacked monitor or keyboard because of their use as routers.
claims_extracted.notes: Explains why surviving units may not look like complete workstation installations.

notes: High-value provenance source for tracing surviving physical NSFNET hardware after decommissioning.
